pages.title: Fertile Bounty
pages.text: §lMax Level: §r II$(br2)§lApplicable Items: §r Hoes$(br2)§lEffect: §r Accelerates the growth of crops within 10 blocks while a hoe is held; when combined with Spring Harvest, harvest drops are doubled.$(br2)§lAcquisition: §r Enchanting Table, Loot Chests, Villager Trades
